_about: Who lives where in the Castle of the Apocalypse II, and which doors their keys open (src/population.py, applied when the world loads, so a rebuild of world/zones keeps it). The owner, 2026-10-12: Kirgan the Destroyer holds the key to the guardian's chamber; Pestilence is in the room right after the door from the Inner Hall; War at the end of the guardian chambers; Famine in the other guardian chambers on the far side (14163); Death the final boss. Mechanics (src/boss_mechanics.py): Pestilence drops plague pools to step out of; War calls the castle's guards at 75% and 40%; Famine starves whoever stands still; Death raises waves of servants and darkens the room as he weakens. Creatures (the owner, 'populate the castle'): regulars (skeletal sentries, plague cultists, hellhound packs, ghouls, gargoyles), elites (a death knight and a hellfire warden on patrol, a plague abomination), sub-bosses (the Bone Marshal, the Ashen Seneschal, the Carrion Queen). Each calls its own kind within a room or two when attacked (allies.py).

bosses.why: Kirgan the Destroyer, in the Guard Room off the inner corridor: he carries the inner gate key (his loot, every time)
Pestilence, in the first Guardian Chamber, through the Inner Hall's locked door

mechanics.why: plague pools at a fighter's feet: step out

bosses.why: War, at The End Of The Guardian Chambers (the east wing)

mechanics.shout: War raises his blade and roars 'TO ME!' The castle's guardians answer!
mechanics.why: calls the castle's guards at 75% and 40%

bosses.why: Famine, in the guardian chambers on the far (west) side

mechanics.warn: Famine's hunger gnaws at all who stand still. Keep moving!

bosses.why: Death, the final boss, at The Gates To Hell

mechanics.shout: Death lifts his scythe, and the dead of the castle rise to serve him!
The light gutters and dies around Death...
mechanics.why: the room darkens as he weakens

doors.name: inner gate
doors.why: the Inner Hall's door into the Guardian Chambers opens to Kirgan's key

22200.name: skeletal sentry skeleton
22200.long_desc: A skeletal sentry stands its post, rusted halberd lowered.
22200.description: Old mail hangs off yellowed bones. Whatever it guarded, it guards still, and it does not tire.

22201.name: plague cultist robed
22201.long_desc: A plague cultist mutters prayers to Pestilence, censer swinging.
22201.description: Sores weep beneath a sackcloth robe. The censer it carries breathes a sweet, sick smoke.

helpers.shout: The cultist shrieks a prayer to Pestilence!

22202.name: hellhound hound
22202.long_desc: A hellhound paces here, embers dripping from its jaws.
22202.description: Black-hided and heavy-shouldered, it smells of brimstone. Where one hunts, the pack is near.

helpers.shout: The hellhound howls for its pack!

22203.name: ravenous ghoul
22203.long_desc: A ravenous ghoul crouches over something it would rather you did not see.
22203.description: Grey skin stretched over hunger. Its claws are long, cracked and black with old blood.

22204.name: stone gargoyle
22204.long_desc: A stone gargoyle perches on the battlement, too still to be stone.
22204.description: Weathered grey wings folded tight; the moss on it stirs when it breathes.

22210.name: death knight
22210.long_desc: A death knight marches the inner halls, black plate ringing.
22210.description: A knight of the castle, dead and risen. Frost crusts its plate; the runes on its blade burn cold blue.

helpers.shout: The death knight raises its blade: the castle wakes!

22211.name: plague abomination
22211.long_desc: A plague abomination lurches here, sewn together from the sick.
22211.description: Too many arms, stitched with wire. Flies follow it in a cloud; its belly sloshes when it moves.

22212.name: hellfire warden demon
22212.long_desc: A hellfire warden stalks the walkway, wreathed in flame.
22212.description: A horned demon bound to keep the walls. It burns where it steps.

22220.name: bone marshal
22220.long_desc: The Bone Marshal stands at the junction, marshalling the dead.
22220.description: A towering skeleton in a commander's rotten tabard. When it raises its baton, the dead fall into ranks.

helpers.shout: The Bone Marshal raises its baton: "RANKS!" The dead of the halls answer!

22221.name: ashen seneschal
22221.long_desc: The Ashen Seneschal waits at the end of the corridor, keys of bone at its belt.
22221.description: Once steward of the castle; now ash given shape. It still keeps the household, and the household is dead.

22222.name: carrion queen
22222.long_desc: The Carrion Queen roosts on the ragged walkway, crows thick about her.
22222.description: A gaunt winged hag in a cloak of black feathers. Every crow on the walls is her eye.

helpers.shout: The Carrion Queen shrieks, and the walls answer!

797200.name: iron bound golem guardian
797200.long_desc: An iron-bound golem stands guard here, its fists the size of anvils.
797200.description: A guardian construct of black iron plates riveted over a core of stone, twice the height of a man. Chains hang from its wrists, and the floor is cracked where it has stamped. It was made to keep these chambers, and it keeps them still.
797200.why: the guardians the chambers are named for
